chunks: Whoever follows the funeral procession of a Muslim will be granted four intercessions on the Day of Judgment, and he does not say anything except that the angel says to him: and for you is the like of that.

key_terms.الْمَلَكُ: the angel who responds to the person's words
key_terms.جَنَازَةَ: funeral procession or bier of the deceased
key_terms.شَفَاعَاتٍ: acts or opportunities of intercession granted as a reward
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final reckoning

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for following the funeral procession of a Muslim?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the merit of accompanying the funeral of a Muslim and the great reward attached to it in the Hereafter. It also indicates that the words a person says on such an occasion bring reciprocal good for the speaker, as the angel responds with the like for him.
